description: Benchmarking the ARHGAP23 zero-binder result against the hit rates of all 266 PDZ domains in the holdup screen
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
D=pd.read_excel("Gogl2022_SupplementaryData1.xlsx",sheet_name="PDZ-PBM interactome")
D["pKd"]=pd.to_numeric(D.COMP_neglogKd,errors="coerce")
D=D[D.pKd.notna()]
g=D.groupby("PDZ").agg(n_measured=("pKd","size"),n_binders=("pKd",lambda v:(v>0).sum()),
                       max_pKd=("pKd","max"),median_binder_pKd=("pKd",lambda v: v[v>0].median()))
g["hit_rate"]=g.n_binders/g.n_measured
g=g.sort_values("n_binders")
g.to_csv("profaff_all_PDZ_domain_hit_rates.csv")
print(f"{len(g)} PDZ domains in ProfAff")
dead=g[g.n_binders==0]
print(f"\ndomains with ZERO binders across the whole screen: {len(dead)} of {len(g)} ({100*len(dead)/len(g):.0f}%)")
print(dead.to_string())
print("\nARHGAP23 rank by number of binders:",int((g.n_binders<=g.loc['ARHGAP23','n_binders']).sum()),"of",len(g))
print("\nARHGAP21 for comparison:"); print(g.loc[["ARHGAP21","ARHGAP23"]].to_string())

print("\n--- how many peptides was each domain tested against? ---")
print(g.n_measured.describe()[["count","min","25%","50%","75%","max"]].to_string())
print(f"  ARHGAP23 tested against {int(g.loc['ARHGAP23','n_measured'])} peptides "
      f"(percentile {100*(g.n_measured<g.loc['ARHGAP23','n_measured']).mean():.0f})")
low=g[g.n_measured<=60]
print(f"  domains tested against <=60 peptides: {len(low)}; of those, zero-binder: {(low.n_binders==0).sum()}")
print(f"  domains tested against >60 peptides: {len(g)-len(low)}; of those, zero-binder: {((g.n_measured>60)&(g.n_binders==0)).sum()}")

# among domains tested on a similar small panel, what hit rate is normal?
print("\n  hit rate among domains tested on 30-60 peptides:")
sim=g[(g.n_measured>=30)&(g.n_measured<=60)]
print(f"    n={len(sim)}, median hit rate {sim.hit_rate.median():.2f}, zero-binder {int((sim.n_binders==0).sum())}")
print(sim.sort_values("hit_rate").head(12).to_string())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.7))
ax[0].hist(g.hit_rate,bins=30,color="#8C8C8C",edgecolor="w")
ax[0].axvline(g.loc["ARHGAP23","hit_rate"],color="#C44E52",lw=2,label="ARHGAP23 (0 of 42)")
ax[0].axvline(g.loc["ARHGAP21","hit_rate"],color="#4C72B0",lw=2,label=f"ARHGAP21 ({int(g.loc['ARHGAP21','n_binders'])} of {int(g.loc['ARHGAP21','n_measured'])})")
ax[0].set_xlabel("fraction of tested peptides bound"); ax[0].set_ylabel("number of PDZ domains")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8.5)
ax[0].set_title(f"Hit rate of all {len(g)} PDZ domains in the holdup screen\n{len(dead)} domains bound nothing at all",fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(g.n_measured,g.n_binders,s=14,alpha=.5,color="#8C8C8C")
ax[1].scatter([g.loc["ARHGAP23","n_measured"]],[g.loc["ARHGAP23","n_binders"]],s=90,color="#C44E52",zorder=5,label="ARHGAP23")
ax[1].scatter([g.loc["ARHGAP21","n_measured"]],[g.loc["ARHGAP21","n_binders"]],s=90,color="#4C72B0",zorder=5,label="ARHGAP21")
ax[1].set_xlabel("peptides tested"); ax[1].set_ylabel("peptides bound"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8.5)
ax[1].set_title("ARHGAP23 was tested on a small panel\nand bound none of it",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
